what_to_detect: A creature with two or more instances of prowess has one fired prowess trigger record per instance for one noncreature spell cast.
near_miss: A creature with one instance of prowess has a single fired prowess trigger record for the cast.
record_fields: acting line of kind Keyword (the keyword's own sidecar line, script API type Keyword)
a granted instance keys to its grantor's static line, not to a Prowess keyword line
